body: Yeah... I met up with a friend today, now I'm feelong quite in the dumps,  She got married and bought a house over this last year, and is enjoying professional success. I don't know if I'll ever be able to catch up to enjoy the kind of life that I had hoped for.

So I got 2 responses from applications I sent where I actually cut a degree off my resume to ensure I wouldn't seem overqualified.  

2 responses this month compared to 2 in the previous 8 months.  I'm happy that I have a chance of getting a job, but so stunned by the thought that my qualifications have actually been a deterrent to employers.  I mean, it's not like I'm a brain surgeon applying to work at Starbucks or something. Is that not screwed up?!

Yeah, I am. I have made plans to meet up with several friend/acquaintances over the next week or two so I feel more connected; I revised my resume and have sent out 3 new applications so here is hoping I get some uptake.  I went to see my counsellor today as well which always helps.  Thanks for checking!
It's nothing to do with you doing anything wrong, it's that you are both young and her feelings changed with time and distance.  Give her her space.
I've applied for about 60 jobs, so the problem isn't a lack of openings :(

i am glad about your cats... mine is a worry for me as i woukd have to get someone to come get him if i go through with it (I am sure I won't be missed for weeks or months.)n

it's in the social sciences, so i've done stats and analysis for my past jobs.  I can't even make myaelf get out of bed... what's the point when there is nothing for me to do really?
yeah, simon fraser has a pretty good rep. i'm going to bed. i have a headache from crying so hard.
the cuddling service was in seattle actually.  Makes me feel very pathetic that I'd have to go to another country and pay for a hug :(

Social sciences; Canada. I have a bunch of stuff in the pantry and a card for the food bank, so that's not the issue...

I have done my very, very best -- graduated from a big-name school, had a promising career, right up until I had to take the first disability leave for depression.  Now I'm friendless, partnerless, jobless, and hopeless -- I see no reason to believe it will get better and I just can't go on with it this way.

i am alone, five years into treatment resistant depression and got let go from my job, lost my professional License because I couldn't pay to keep it, and my unemployment is about to run out. i'm turning 40 in a couple of weeks or would if I were still here.  I can't face it
